headline:
Textile engineering,
with a practical mind.
description: I’m a final-year Textile Engineering student in Dhaka, exploring how fabric, production, and quality come together. I learn by asking questions—and making things.
gallery_intro: A few frames from learning, making, and everything in between.
gallery_page_description: Learning, making, and the moments worth keeping.
updates_intro: Small steps, new questions, and what I’m learning along the way.
typewriter_phrases: Textile engineering, with a practical mind.
about_teaser:
I’m Ariful Islam Fahim, a final-year Textile Engineering student at Green University of Bangladesh, specializing in Apparel Manufacturing.

I’m interested in materials, production and quality—and the practical questions between them.
closing_heading: Good work starts with a conversation.
